failures.source: youtube:ivDj7I9elZA (Custom Event Pandora - ADDED 8.8, project-gamers-oficial, uploaded 2026-05-19)
failures.operation: transcript capture -- root-caused this time by going past the transcript-panel UI entirely and reading window.ytInitialPlayerResponse.captions directly, then fetching the actual caption track URL (YouTube's own official timedtext API endpoint -- the same one the transcript panel itself calls, not a workaround)
failures.reason: DEFINITIVE ROOT CAUSE FOUND: the video's caption track metadata IS registered and advertised (1 track: Portuguese, kind=asr/auto-generated, isTranslatable=true) -- so the transcript panel correctly shows a 'Mostrar transcrição' button and appears to load. But fetching the actual caption content from the track's own baseUrl (https://www.youtube.com/api/timedtext?v=...&kind=asr&lang=pt) returns HTTP 200 with a completely EMPTY body, tried across all 4 known format variants (plain XML, fmt=srv3, fmt=json3, fmt=vtt). This is not a tooling bug and not a bypassable restriction -- it is YouTube's own official caption-delivery endpoint returning nothing for a track it itself claims exists. Most likely explanation: auto-caption generation was scheduled/registered by YouTube at upload time but the actual transcription processing has not completed (or stalled) for this specific video. All 3 stuck videos in this batch (A2BcRITQjxc 2026-07-31, QJclT4HLaMg 2026-07-30, ivDj7I9elZA 2026-05-19) are recent 2026 uploads, in contrast to the 12 successfully-transcribed videos (all 2019-2024) -- strongly suggesting auto-caption processing lag/backlog for this channel's more recent uploads is the systemic cause, not anything specific to these 3 videos' content.
failures.nextAction: Retry in weeks/months -- if this is a processing backlog, the caption content may eventually populate for the same already-registered track. CORRECTION (see fkaG0dVg2w0 entry below): the 'prioritize older videos' mitigation this note originally suggested was tested against 4 more videos and only partially holds -- 3 older (2022) videos succeeded immediately, but a 4th 2022 video (fkaG0dVg2w0) showed the exact same empty-caption-content fault. Age is correlated but not deterministic; treat as a genuine per-video, roughly-random fault rate (~40-60% observed this session) rather than a fixable-by-reordering issue.
